entities.name: Princess Maria Carlotta of Parma
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Maria Carlotta of Parma was a Princess of Parma and Infanta of Spain, daughter of Ferdinand I, Duke of Parma and Archduchess Maria Amalia of Austria. She joined the Dominican Order under the name of Sister Giacinta Domenica.
